#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage only independent p5-admin transport access. No owner authority material.
set -euo pipefail
SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/common.sh"
ADMIN_PUB=""; PHASE=""; YES=0
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --admin-ssh-public-key) ADMIN_PUB="${2:-}"; shift ;;
    --phase) PHASE="${2:-}"; shift ;;
    --yes) YES=1 ;;
    *) die "unknown option: $1" ;;
  esac
  shift
done
[ -n "$ADMIN_PUB" ] || die "missing --admin-ssh-public-key"
admin_fp="$(validate_ssh_public_key "$ADMIN_PUB")" || die "invalid admin public key"
agent_fps="$(agent_pubkey_fingerprints)"
[ -n "$agent_fps" ] || die "agent fingerprints indeterminate"
printf '%s\n' "$agent_fps" | grep -qx "$(printf '%s\n' "$admin_fp" | awk '{print $2}')" &&
  die "admin key equals agent key" || true
if [ "$YES" != 1 ]; then
  log "PLAN: stage p5-admin transport public key only; owner anchor/account untouched"
  exit 0
fi
require_root
assert_executor_is_not_agent
require_ceremony_confirmation admin-recovery-stage "$PHASE" "$YES"
[ "${P5_INDEPENDENT_ADMIN_RECOVERY_PROVEN:-NO}" = YES ] ||
  die "independent admin/provider recovery proof required"
id "$ADMIN_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash "$ADMIN_USER"
home="$(getent passwd "$ADMIN_USER" | cut -d: -f6)"
tokens="$(sshd_effective_akf "$ADMIN_USER" "${P5_SSHD_HOST_CONTEXT:-localhost}" "${P5_SSHD_ADDR_CONTEXT:-127.0.0.1}")" ||
  die "p5-admin Match-aware AuthorizedKeysFile indeterminate"
target="$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"; hit=0
for token in $tokens; do
  validate_akf_token "$token"
  [ "$(akf_expand_token "$token" "$ADMIN_USER" "$home")" = "$target" ] && hit=1
done
[ "$hit" = 1 ] || die "p5-admin effective AuthorizedKeysFile does not include $target"
install -d -m 0700 -o "$ADMIN_USER" -g "$ADMIN_USER" "$home/.ssh"
install -m 0600 -o "$ADMIN_USER" -g "$ADMIN_USER" "$ADMIN_PUB" "$target"
[ ! -e /etc/p5/owner/owner_ed25519.pub ] || die "owner anchor must not exist at admin stage"
log "ADMIN_RECOVERY_STAGE=APPLIED; prove a fresh p5-admin login before phase 03"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# common.sh -- shared, fail-closed helpers for the P5 owner/admin trust-domain
# cutover package (final, supersedes reports/hardening-script-draft).
#
# HARD CONTRACT (closes review defects C2/H3/H8/H9):
#   * The privilege-removal target is the FIXED principal AGENT_USER (default
#     k3). It is NEVER derived from `id -un`, `$USER`, or `$SUDO_USER`.
#     Those three are read ONLY to print a diagnostic banner and to fail closed
#     if the operator accidentally aims the cutover at the executing account.
#   * Public material only. Any input that looks like a PRIVATE key is rejected.
#   * Missing required material fails closed (nonzero exit), never "best effort".
#   * Sourcing this file changes no system state.
#
# shellcheck shell=bash
# shellcheck disable=SC2317  # helpers are invoked by the phase scripts

# --- fixed principals (explicit defaults; parameterizable, never inferred) ---
AGENT_USER="${P5_AGENT_USER:-k3}"
OWNER_USER="${P5_OWNER_USER:-p5-owner}"
ADMIN_USER="${P5_ADMIN_USER:-p5-admin}"

# Root-equivalent groups whose membership must be removed from AGENT_USER.
# disk=raw block devices, shadow=/etc/shadow read, root=gid0 group-writable trust => all root-equivalent.
ROOT_EQUIVALENT_GROUPS=(sudo wheel admin docker lxd google-sudoers disk shadow root)

# --- logging / fail-closed -------------------------------------------------
log()  { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" "$*"; }
warn() { printf '[WARN] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
die()  { printf '[FATAL] %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
have() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }

# A phase script must call this first.
strict_mode() { set -euo pipefail; }

require_root() {
  [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ] || die "must run as root (real ceremony executor is root/${ADMIN_USER}); refusing"
}

# Guard against the historical defect: never let the executing identity BE the
# deprivileging target. If the operator runs the cutover while logged in as the
# agent, abort -- the ceremony requires an independent admin context.
assert_executor_is_not_agent() {
  local who diag
  who="$(id -un 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"      # diagnostic only
  diag="${SUDO_USER:-}"
  if [ "$who" = "$AGENT_USER" ] || [ "$diag" = "$AGENT_USER" ]; then
    die "executor resolves to AGENT_USER='$AGENT_USER' (id -un=$who SUDO_USER=${diag:-<none>}); the cutover must be driven by an independent admin/root, not the agent"
  fi
  log "executor diagnostic: id -un=$who SUDO_USER=${diag:-<none>}; deprivilege target is FIXED AGENT_USER=$AGENT_USER"
}

assert_agent_user_resolves() {
  id "$AGENT_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "AGENT_USER='$AGENT_USER' does not resolve to a real account"
  log "AGENT_USER=$AGENT_USER resolves (uid=$(id -u "$AGENT_USER"))"
}

# --- public-key input interface (no private keys ever) ---------------------
# Reject anything that looks like private key material, whatever the flag.
reject_if_private_key() {
  local path="$1"
  [ -f "$path" ] || die "key file not found: $path"
  if LC_ALL=C grep -qiE 'PRIVATE KEY|BEGIN (OPENSSH|RSA|EC|DSA|PGP) PRIVATE|PuTTY-User-Key-File' "$path" 2>/dev/null; then
    die "input '$path' looks like a PRIVATE key; only PUBLIC material is accepted"
  fi
  return 0
}

# OpenSSH public key (authorized_keys line). Returns SHA256 fingerprint.
validate_ssh_public_key() {
  local path="$1" fp nkl
  reject_if_private_key "$path"
  nkl="$(grep -cvE '^\s*(#|$)' "$path" 2>/dev/null)" || nkl=0
  if [ "$nkl" -ne 1 ]; then
    die "ssh public key '$path' must contain exactly one key line"
  fi
  grep -qE '^\s*(ssh-ed25519|ssh-rsa|ecdsa-sha2-[a-z0-9-]+|sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com|sk-ecdsa-sha2-[a-z0-9-]+@openssh.com) ' "$path" \
    || die "ssh public key '$path' is not a recognized OpenSSH public key line"
  have ssh-keygen || die "ssh-keygen required to validate '$path'"
  fp="$(ssh-keygen -lf "$path" 2>/dev/null)" || die "ssh-keygen could not parse public key '$path'"
  printf '%s\n' "$fp"
}

# Raw RFC-8032 Ed25519 owner authority PUBLIC key: exactly 32 bytes, not a private key.
validate_ed25519_raw_public_key() {
  local path="$1" size
  reject_if_private_key "$path"

# Fail closed if any agent fingerprint appears in the given authorized_keys file.
assert_agent_key_absent_from() {
  local target="$1" tfp afp agent_fps tfps keylines
  [ -f "$target" ] || { log "no $target (agent key trivially absent)"; return 0; }
  have ssh-keygen || die "ssh-keygen required to fingerprint $target"
  agent_fps="$(agent_pubkey_fingerprints)" || true
  [ -n "$agent_fps" ] || die "agent fingerprint indeterminate (fail-closed) for $target"
  tfps="$(ssh-keygen -lf "$target" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')" || true   # capture must not abort under caller set -e; the unparseable die below is the fail-closed path
  keylines="$(grep -cvE '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' "$target" 2>/dev/null)" || keylines=0
  # target has key line(s) but none could be fingerprinted => unparseable => fail closed.
  if [ -z "$tfps" ] && [ "${keylines:-0}" -ne 0 ]; then
    die "cannot fingerprint key(s) in $target (unparseable); fail-closed"
  fi
  while IFS= read -r tfp; do
    [ -n "$tfp" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r afp; do
      [ -n "$afp" ] || continue
      [ "$tfp" = "$afp" ] && die "AGENT key fingerprint $afp is present in $target (forbidden)"
    done <<EOF
$agent_fps
EOF
  done <<EOF2
$tfps
EOF2
  log "agent key absent from $target (OK)"
}

# Effective per-principal AuthorizedKeysFile tokens.  Match blocks are applied
# by sshd -T -C; callers must supply the principal and must fail closed.
sshd_effective_akf() {
  local principal="${1:-}" host="${2:-localhost}" addr="${3:-127.0.0.1}" out
  [ -n "$principal" ] || return 1
  have sshd || return 1
  out="$(sshd -T -C "user=$principal,host=$host,addr=$addr" 2>/dev/null |
    awk 'tolower($1)=="authorizedkeysfile"{$1="";sub(/^ +/,"");print;exit}')" || true
  [ -n "$out" ] || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$out"
}

# Expand one sshd AuthorizedKeysFile token for a user ($1=token $2=user $3=home).
akf_expand_token() {
  local t="$1" u="$2" h="$3" x

  case "$x" in /*) printf '%s\n' "$x" ;; *) printf '%s/%s\n' "$h" "$x" ;; esac
}

validate_akf_token() {
  local token="$1" stripped
  stripped="$(printf '%s' "$token" | sed 's/%%//g;s/%h//g;s/%u//g')"
  case "$stripped" in *%*) die "unsupported AuthorizedKeysFile token: $token" ;; esac
  case "$token" in *$'\n'*|*$'\r'*) die "newline in AuthorizedKeysFile token" ;; esac

1 | #!/usr/bin/env bash
  2 | # Stage only independent p5-admin transport access. No owner authority material.
  3 | set -euo pipefail
  4 | SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
  5 | . "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/common.sh"
  6 | ADMIN_PUB=""; PHASE=""; YES=0
  7 | while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  8 |   case "$1" in
  9 |     --admin-ssh-public-key) ADMIN_PUB="${2:-}"; shift ;;
 10 |     --phase) PHASE="${2:-}"; shift ;;
 11 |     --yes) YES=1 ;;
 12 |     *) die "unknown option: $1" ;;
 13 |   esac
 14 |   shift
 15 | done
 16 | [ -n "$ADMIN_PUB" ] || die "missing --admin-ssh-public-key"
 17 | admin_fp="$(validate_ssh_public_key "$ADMIN_PUB")" || die "invalid admin public key"
 18 | agent_fps="$(agent_pubkey_fingerprints)"
 19 | [ -n "$agent_fps" ] || die "agent fingerprints indeterminate"
 20 | printf '%s\n' "$agent_fps" | grep -qx "$(printf '%s\n' "$admin_fp" | awk '{print $2}')" &&
 21 |   die "admin key equals agent key" || true
 22 | if [ "$YES" != 1 ]; then
 23 |   log "PLAN: stage p5-admin transport public key only; owner anchor/account untouched"
 24 |   exit 0
 25 | fi
 26 | require_root
 27 | assert_executor_is_not_agent
 28 | require_ceremony_confirmation admin-recovery-stage "$PHASE" "$YES"
 29 | [ "${P5_INDEPENDENT_ADMIN_RECOVERY_PROVEN:-NO}" = YES ] ||
 30 |   die "independent admin/provider recovery proof required"
 31 | id "$ADMIN_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash "$ADMIN_USER"
 32 | home="$(getent passwd "$ADMIN_USER" | cut -d: -f6)"
 33 | tokens="$(sshd_effective_akf "$ADMIN_USER" "${P5_SSHD_HOST_CONTEXT:-localhost}" "${P5_SSHD_ADDR_CONTEXT:-127.0.0.1}")" ||
 34 |   die "p5-admin Match-aware AuthorizedKeysFile indeterminate"
 35 | target="$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"; hit=0
 36 | for token in $tokens; do
 37 |   validate_akf_token "$token"
 38 |   [ "$(akf_expand_token "$token" "$ADMIN_USER" "$home")" = "$target" ] && hit=1
 39 | done
 40 | [ "$hit" = 1 ] || die "p5-admin effective AuthorizedKeysFile does not include $target"
 41 | install -d -m 0700 -o "$ADMIN_USER" -g "$ADMIN_USER" "$home/.ssh"
 42 | install -m 0600 -o "$ADMIN_USER" -g "$ADMIN_USER" "$ADMIN_PUB" "$target"
 43 | [ ! -e /etc/p5/owner/owner_ed25519.pub ] || die "owner anchor must not exist at admin stage"
 44 | log "ADMIN_RECOVERY_STAGE=APPLIED; prove a fresh p5-admin login before phase 03"
